### More Than a Creature
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/more-than-a-creature
Passage: Isaiah 7:14
Points:
- Fallen descendants of Adam cannot redeem sinners, requiring a sinless yet fully human Mediator.
- When King Ahaz feigned piety and refused God's offer of a sign, the Lord promised the sign of Immanuel Himself.
- The prophecy found its ultimate fulfillment in Jesus, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit and born of a virgin.
- Christ represents God's radical intervention in history as one who is both truly God and truly man.
- Rejecting God's promise leads to judgment, while receiving Christ calls for deep gratitude and obedience.

### A Miraculous Conception
Author: Truth For Life
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-december-25-2019.html
Passage: Isaiah 7:14
Points:
- The virgin birth is an unprecedented miracle fulfilling the ancient promise of the woman's seed.
- Although Christ took on genuine human nature, He remained the Holy One of God free from sin.
- God selected Mary in humble obscurity rather than seeking worldly stature or royalty.
- The name Immanuel reveals that God participates with His people in earthly sorrow, labor, death, and resurrection triumph.
